# MongoDB time-series indexes and metaField design — concept pack

> Time series collections support [secondary indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-secondary-index.md#std-label-timeseries-add-secondary-index) on the field specified as the `metaField`. If the data model of your time series data does not have a designated field for your metadata, you can transform your data to create one. To transform the data in your existing coll (from www.mongodb.com)
